'''Trina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Trina worked as a poacher. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a meteorite crashed onto the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] and awoke a [[Dorumaan leviathan]], a type of giant sea creature. Trina and some other poachers planned to kill the creature and then loot ivory from its corpse. However, the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], attempted to save the leviathan by attacking the poachers. Trina and three other poachers tried to fight the heroes while the poachers [[Harkaan]] and [[Pardo]] attacked the leviathan with a submersible. However, the heroes eventually defeated the poachers and saved the leviathan.
